description: Sanitized public HTTPS download measurements through independent clients and the actual active Clash client; no server address or credentials

mac_buffer_crossover.decision: reverted: three crossover pairs did not show repeatable throughput improvement; both settings had zero new global UDP full-buffer drops

client_interface_comparison.decision: restored automatic interface selection; explicit en1 did not improve measured download throughput

final_20mb.scope: actual active Clash HTTP proxy, Hysteria2 prioritized, TUN enabled with own VPS /32 excluded

production.tun_exclusion: only own VPS /32; actual address intentionally omitted

evidence_notes.units: Mbps are decimal megabits per second; MB are decimal bytes. Final HTTPS requests completed with expected 200/206 responses and TLS verification.
evidence_notes.causality: Results vary by file size, time, core version and connection state. Earlier and final phases are not a controlled estimate of any individual production change.
evidence_notes.failed_cases: Timeout/connection errors remain in client_state_history and must not be counted as successful bandwidth samples. The hy2-macbuf-1 readiness failures occurred during a restart before the proxy listener was ready.
evidence_notes.loss: Mac full-buffer counters are system-wide; zero delta is not proof of zero end-to-end packet loss. Earlier unbound UDP/ICMP probes included active TUN processing and do not establish bare ISP loss.
evidence_notes.kernel_limits: Official suggested macOS 20 MB maxsockbuf and 16 MB recvspace writes were rejected by this kernel with Result too large; values stayed unchanged. A 4 MB recvspace trial succeeded and was later reverted after crossover measurements.
evidence_notes.privacy: Server address, subscription URL, UUID, passwords, obfuscation keys and WebSocket path are omitted.
